entries.title: Rag-Coat Stake Scarecrow
entries.description: One newly authored whole static field-scarecrow appearance: a ground stake and crossarm support an asymmetric thick rag-coat body with two drooping sleeves and genuinely jagged hem outline, two unequal hanging trouser legs, two jagged bundled-straw hand silhouettes, an anonymous sack head and a broad-brim peaked straw-hat form. Nine closed editable meshes, five opaque constant matte PBR roles. No old laundry shirt or beekeeping hat geometry is imported or extracted: all numerical body, clothes, straw and hat outlines are newly authored as one farm field fixture. Clothes and hat are closed solid game-art volumes, not hollow wearable tailoring; small fixed overlaps are explicit. Metres, Z up, whole horizontal bounds centre, stake sole at Z0. Inanimate stylised prop only, no identity of a person, rig, wind/cloth simulation, actual pest-deterrence, real installation, stability, weatherproofing or safety claim.

entries.title: Twin-Track Clay Storage Chest
entries.description: One original static empty clay-storage chest from the ceramics storage-box plan. A single thick deep rectangular shell has a complete bottom and unpartitioned open cavity. Two continuous side rails each contain two genuine full-length recessed channels; two separate thick cover panels sit at different fixed heights and overlap toward the rear, leaving a clear front access opening. Each cover has a true rectangular finger aperture. Five closed pieces, three constant opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up, front -Y, grounded centred origin. Newly authored shell, dual-channel cross-sections and pierced covers, not a resized round jar, six-compartment bait box, cushioned seatbox or low-front picking bin.
